name: Rayavadee

rooms.type: Family Pavilion with Pool (167 sq m, 4 guests)

highlights: Spectacular, secluded location on the tip of the Railay peninsula, surrounded on three sides by white-sand beaches (Railay West, Railay East and Phra Nang) and towering limestone cliffs, reachable only by longtail boat
Ranked #1 hotel in Railay Beach on TripAdvisor and rated 9.4/10 on Booking.com (couples score 9.6) - consistently praised as a once-in-a-lifetime stay
Spacious two-story Thai-pavilion accommodation (Terrace Pavilions ~115 sq m, larger pool and family pavilions) set amid lush tropical gardens
Warm, attentive and genuinely friendly service repeatedly singled out by guests
The Grotto - an iconic restaurant set inside a natural cave right on Phra Nang Beach - plus strong breakfast and multiple dining venues
Beautiful pool, direct access to some of Thailand's most famous beaches, and abundant nature and wildlife around the resort
cons: Very expensive - among the priciest resorts in Krabi, with rates starting around 14,000 THB and villas far higher
On-site food and drink prices are steep; some guests recommend eating at cheaper Railay restaurants
Access only by boat means transfers can be wet or awkward with luggage, and beaches get busy with day-trippers
Resident monkeys can be aggressive and steal food/belongings; a few guests felt some pavilions are showing their age
notes: Confirmed REAL and currently operating: Rayavadee (SHA Extra Plus) is Krabi's flagship 5-star luxury resort, occupying the tip of the Railay/Phra Nang peninsula and accessible only by boat. Verified across Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, TripAdvisor (#1 of ~9 Railay hotels, ~2,900 reviews) and the official site rayavadee.com. Property has 94 pavilions + 7 villas. Zone is best described as the Phra Nang / Railay peninsula - it fronts Railay West, Railay East and Phra Nang beaches. Booking overall score 9.4/10 (599-801 verified reviews); TripAdvisor 4.0/5. Agoda and Trip.com numeric scores were not accessible (Booking/Trip pages returned bot-block/418, so those were left blank rather than guessed). Prices are approximate USD->THB conversions (~36 THB/USD): cheapest Deluxe Pavilion ~USD 383-400/night; KAYAK showed a recent USD 580-858 range; villas require phone booking and cost far more. Room THB figures are estimates derived from published USD rates, not exact live quotes. Agoda URL uses slug 'rayavadee-hotel' (no h-number found); append cid as needed.

name: Railay Bay Resort & Spa
highlights: Rare property that stretches right across the Railay peninsula, with direct beachfront on Railay West and its own frontage on Railay East
Spacious stand-alone cottages and villas set in tropical gardens, many with private balconies and jacuzzis
Two swimming pools including a beachfront pool, plus the on-site Railay Spa
Free daily minibar replenishment and breakfast praised by many guests
Dramatic limestone-cliff scenery and wildlife (monkeys, hornbills) right at the resort
Central Railay location within easy walking distance of Phra Nang Beach, viewpoints and the rock-climbing spots
cons: Reviewers repeatedly call it overpriced for the quality of food and amenities
Maintenance and dated-room complaints - some report old/dark rooms, uncomfortable pillows, occasional sewage smell or mosquitoes
Service can feel understaffed and inconsistent in busy periods
Restaurant gets crowded with day-trippers and lunch service can be slow; limited sunbeds fill up early
Reachable by boat only (approx 15-20 min from Ao Nang / Ao Nam Mao), which some guests found poorly explained at booking
notes: Confirmed REAL and currently operating 4-star beachfront resort on Railay Beach, Krabi. It is one of the few resorts occupying the full width of the Railay peninsula: its main beachfront/two pools are on Railay West, and it has a secondary frontage/entrance on Railay East (some listings describe a west-to-east orientation), so it can legitimately be tagged Railay West. Guest scores verified: Booking.com 8.5/10 ("Very Good") from 3,752 reviews; Trip.com 8.6/10 from ~203 reviews; TripAdvisor 3.5/5 from ~2,876 reviews, ranked #6 of 9 Railay Beach hotels. Agoda score NOT confirmed (page would not load - left blank rather than guess). Pricing: THB figures are approximate conversions from USD deals seen across aggregators (cheapest ~USD 91-116, deals ranging ~USD 105-235/night); room-type names/prices are indicative, verify exact rates and category names on the live booking pages before publishing. Agoda URL is the real slug page I saw (no hNNNN id variant was exposed); Booking and Trip.com URLs verified from search results. Official site krabi-railaybay.com has real photos of this specific property (also railaybayresortandspa.hotels-krabi.com and Trip.com galleries).

name: Railay Princess Resort & Spa
highlights: Prime Railay East location right on the floating pier — long-tail boat access and a 5-minute walk across to Railay West beach and the walking-street restaurants
Dramatic limestone-cliff and Andaman Sea/mountain (Petch Mountain) scenery from the grounds
Two swimming pools including a rooftop pool with cliff and mountain views plus a garden pool
Generous, well-liked breakfast buffet with an egg/cooking station and varied options
Welcoming, efficient front-desk staff and smooth check-in/check-out (many reviewers single out helpful service)
On-site Railay Princess Spa, kids' club, fitness centre and restaurant; large 126-room resort with tropical gardens, marketed as Halal-friendly
cons: Recurring mold/musty smell complaints, especially in ground-floor and budget rooms — several guests flagged it as a health concern
Aging, worn furniture and dated fixtures in the cheaper room categories; quality varies a lot by room type
Wild monkeys frequently raid balconies and the pool areas
Inconsistent restaurant/dining service and mixed management responses to complaints reported by some guests
notes:
CONFIRMED real and currently operating. It's a 3-star (official site) beachfront resort & spa on Railay East Beach, Ao Nang, Krabi — directly on the Railay floating pier, boat-access only, ~5 min walk to Railay West. 126 rooms, two pools (incl. rooftop), spa, kids club, fitness, restaurant.

Star rating: official site says 3-star; some OTAs (Booking/Expedia) list it as 4-star — I used 3.

SCORES: I could not load Booking/Agoda/Trip.com directly (they block automated fetch — HTTP 418/empty), so I left scoreBooking/scoreAgoda/scoreTrip blank rather than invent numbers. Real data points I DID see: TripAdvisor 3.6/5 (ranked #56 of 203 hotels in Ao Nang, d596184); HotelsCombined aggregate 8.4/10 from ~5,016 reviews. Consider these approximate references, not the exact per-site figures.

PRICING: Cheapest confirmed entry rate is THB ~1,294/night (official h-rez booking engine and multiple OTAs; roughly USD 43-57). Room-category names are confirmed from the official site (Standard, Superior, Deluxe, Premier, Grand Deluxe, Junior Suite Corner) but only the ~1,294 entry price is firm — the Deluxe/Grand Deluxe/Junior Suite prices in the rooms array are APPROXIMATE estimates for tiering, not scraped quotes; verify against live OTA rates before publishing.

URLs: Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com detail URLs above are the canonical property pages (Agoda slug page had no hNNNN id visible; Trip.com property id 710552). Official site krabi-railayprincess.com (and railayprincessresortspa.com-krabi.com) plus the TripAdvisor page d596184 have real photos of this specific hotel.

name: Sand Sea Resort Railay

rooms.type: Tropical Chalay (35 sqm, Sunrise Wing) - cheapest
Junior Suite Cottage (48 sqm, Sunset Wing)

highlights: Prime location spanning both Railay West and Railay East beaches, direct beachfront with easy 5-minute walk between the two beaches
Stunning limestone-cliff and Andaman Sea sunset views right from the resort grounds
Multiple outdoor swimming pools (guests mention up to three) with different vibes to choose from
Friendly, helpful and attentive staff repeatedly praised for quick service and genuine hospitality
Beachfront breakfast and the Sand Sea Restaurant serving local and international dishes right by the sand
Lush tropical garden setting with resident dusky leaf monkeys and steps-away access to Phra Nang Cave and Princess Lagoon
cons: Some rooms/bungalows feel dated and in need of renovation - reports of rusted bathroom fixtures, creaking floors and dim lighting
Sunbed hoarding by other guests (towels reserving loungers) is a common complaint
Maintenance niggles noted: air-con vents, shower drainage and worn furnishings in older units
Restaurant/breakfast quality can be inconsistent - mediocre coffee and sometimes limited fresh fruit
notes: Confirmed REAL and currently operating. Official site krabisandsea.com is live and lists 2025 rooms/rates; ranked #2 of 9 hotels in Railay Beach on Tripadvisor with 3,367 reviews (3.8/5, 3.5-star class), and a 2025 Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice award. Located on Railay West beachfront (accessible only by boat via Nam Mao Pier or Ao Nang). Guest scores verified: Trip.com 9.1/10 (295 reviews); HotelsCombined aggregate 8.4/10 ("Excellent", 6,860 ratings); Booking.com couples-location subscore 9.4. I could NOT see the exact overall Booking.com or Agoda /10 headline number, so those fields are left blank rather than guessed. PRICING CAVEAT: neither the official site nor the platform snippets published per-room THB rates; the cheapest cross-platform rate seen was roughly USD 51-72/night (~1,800-2,500 THB), so priceFromTHB is ~2,200 and the individual room THB prices are tier-based ESTIMATES, not quoted figures - verify live before publishing. Six room types confirmed from official site: Sunset Wing (Deluxe Bungalow 40sqm, Grand Deluxe Building 48sqm, Junior Suite Cottage 48sqm) and Sunrise Wing (Tropical Chalay 35sqm, Tropical Villa 45sqm, Tropical Villa Plus 60sqm). Trip.com hotel id 1516706; Agoda slug sand-sea-resort/hotel/krabi-th.html; Booking slug th/sand-sea-resort. Additional real-photo pages available: Trip.com photo gallery (us.trip.com/hotels/krabi-hotel-detail-1516706/sand-sea-resort/photo.html) and Tripadvisor.

name: Railay Village Resort & Spa

rooms.type: Deluxe Pool View (44 sqm, king + sofa bed)
Deluxe Pool Side (44 sqm, direct pool access)
Jacuzzi Villa (50 sqm, private jacuzzi tub)

highlights: Prime beachfront location on Railay West, steps from the sand with famous sunset views
Only reachable by longtail boat, so it feels tranquil and secluded among limestone cliffs
Two outdoor pools, one peaceful and shaded, set in lush tropical gardens with resident wildlife
Spacious 44 sqm rooms with king bed, sofa bed and private balcony
Walking distance to Railay's walking street with bars, restaurants and the East-side pier
Friendly, helpful staff and smooth private boat/taxi transfer arrangements
cons: Rooms and interiors feel dated with maintenance and cleanliness lapses (stained linens noted)
A/C is tied to the key card so it shuts off when you leave the room
Not enough sunbeds for the number of guests, and average, slow-to-replenish breakfast
On-property dry policy in parts / limited alcohol, plus occasionally unreliable WiFi
notes: Confirmed REAL and currently operating (official site railayvillagekrabi.com active with 2026 room updates incl. a new Jacuzzi Suite Villa launching Nov 2026). Located on Railay West Beach, Ao Nang, Muang, Krabi (544 Moo 2), accessible only by boat. Classified 4-star (GIATA via TripAdvisor); markets itself as a Thai boutique family/couple resort. Guest scores: Booking.com 8.2/10 (1,450 verified reviews), Agoda 8.4/10 (~4,862 reviews), TripAdvisor 3.8/5 (1,222 reviews, ranked ~#63 of 203 in Ao Nang). Room types from the official accommodation page: Deluxe Pool View, Deluxe Pool Side, Jacuzzi Villa, Honeymoon Suite (plus upcoming Jacuzzi Suite Villa). THB prices are APPROXIMATE conversions from USD listings (TripAdvisor standard rooms ~$93-160; Trip.com/KAYAK from ~$87; occasional off-season deals reported far lower) at ~35.5 THB/USD — exact THB rates were not directly visible because Agoda/Booking/Trip.com pages blocked automated fetch (returned empty JS shells or HTTP 418). Agoda URL is the canonical detail page I saw but WITHOUT the -hNNNN slug id (site rendered as JS shell so the numeric id wasn't captured); verify/append cid separately. Trip.com internal hotel id is 710557.

name: Sunrise Tropical Resort Railay
highlights: Spacious, well-kept villas set among lush tropical gardens and coconut palms — considered some of the best midrange value on Railay
Excellent central location on the isthmus: about 5 minutes' walk to Railay West Beach and ~15 minutes to Phra Nang Beach
Friendly, helpful staff and good service consistently praised in guest reviews
Villas feature big bathrooms with Jacuzzi tubs and rock-garden/outdoor showers, king bed and silk daybed
Good included breakfast with fruit, cereals, pastries, bread and cooked-to-order dishes
Quiet, green, relaxed grounds with an outdoor pool and beachfront restaurant serving Thai and international food
cons: No direct beach access — the resort sits back from the water and it's a short walk across the isthmus to the swimmable beaches
Located on the Railay East (mangrove) side, whose shoreline is muddy/tidal and not suitable for swimming
Some rooms and facilities feel dated, and TV has only limited English-language channels
Food and drink prices are high (typical of Railay's island-logistics premium)
notes: CONFIRMED REAL and currently operating on Railay East Beach, Krabi (39 Moo 2, Ao Nang, Muang). Opened 2008; ~28 two-storey villas + 12 rooms. Self-classified 4-star; some sources list it 3.5-star. Guest scores verified: Agoda 8.2/10 (~2,861 reviews), Expedia 8.4/10 (Very Good), Tripadvisor 4/5. Could NOT confirm exact Booking.com or Trip.com hotel-detail URLs from search results (they did not surface and a direct Booking.com fetch returned empty), so those fields and scoreBooking/scoreTrip are left blank rather than fabricated — likely candidates to verify manually are booking.com/hotel/th/sunrise-tropical-resort.html and the Trip.com Krabi listing. The Agoda URL shown is the canonical slug form actually seen in search results (no hNNNN id was exposed). Prices: travelfish notes ~1,500–4,000 THB walk-in; seasonal deals advertised from ~$69 (~2,450 THB); room-type THB values above are approximate. Photo source (oyster.com) has real, honest photos and an independent review of this specific property. Additional real-photo pages seen: hotels.com/ho323758 and expedia.com/Krabi-Hotels-Sunrise-Tropical-Resort.h2758329.

name: Anyavee Railay Resort
highlights: Prime, well-priced base right on Railay East, a short 5-10 minute walk across the peninsula to Railay West beach, restaurants and shops
Genuine value for money for the Railay area, which is otherwise dominated by pricey resorts
Friendly, accommodating staff frequently praised by guests
Outdoor pool plus a separate children's pool and an on-site restaurant/beach bar
62 rooms including rustic wooden bungalows with balconies set in green, scenic grounds framed by Railay's limestone karsts
Walkable location (90/100 walk grade) close to Phra Nang Cave and the longtail/ferry pier
cons: Aging infrastructure - several rooms feel dated and in need of renovation, with reports of stains, odors and worn fittings
Inconsistent housekeeping and room quality; some guests report rooms only cleaned on request
Weak, unreliable WiFi
Breakfast is basic/uninspiring, and there are recurring complaints about mosquitoes and monkey/trash issues
notes:
Confirmed REAL and currently operating. A 3-star beachfront bungalow resort on Railay East (Phra Nang peninsula), Krabi; official address 390 Moo 2, Ao Nang, Krabi 81000. 62 A/C rooms with balconies, outdoor + kids pool, restaurant/beach bar, free WiFi. Verified live listings on Agoda, Trip.com, Hotels.com, Expedia, KAYAK, Tripadvisor.

SCORES: Trip.com 6.2/10 (breakdown cleanliness/amenities/location/service all ~6.2). Tripadvisor 3.0/5 from 484 reviews, ranked #8 of ~9-10 Railay Beach hotels. I could NOT retrieve the live Agoda guest score or a Booking.com score (Agoda page rendered JS-only/empty; no dedicated Booking.com page for this property surfaced in search — only other Anyavee properties like Tubkaek/Klong Muang appear on Booking.com), so scoreAgoda and scoreBooking are left blank rather than invented.

PRICING: 'Rates from THB672' per the official h-rez booking page; KAYAK lists from ~$28 (~980 THB). Room TYPES are confirmed from Trip.com (Standard Twin, Superior Room, Bungalow, Wooden Bungalow). The per-room THB prices I returned are APPROXIMATE anchors — only the ~672 THB floor and one guest report of ~1300 THB for a bungalow are hard data points; exact per-room rates vary by date and were not directly visible, so treat room prices as estimates, not scraped figures.

name: Railay Great View Resort

rooms.type: Deluxe Cottage (36 sqm, partial ocean view)
Grand Deluxe Cottage (42 sqm, mountain/sea view)

highlights: Stunning jungle-and-cliff setting on East Railay with resident monkeys and flying squirrels overhead
Swimming pool and terraces framed by dramatic Railay limestone karst and sea views
Private beach access and a peaceful, secluded feel away from the main tourist crowds
Spacious, tropical-style cottages with wooden furnishings and balconies
Friendly, welcoming staff and good on-site Lae Lay restaurant/breakfast
Strong value for a Railay beachfront property, popular with budget-to-mid travelers
cons: Longtail boat engine noise from the East Railay pier can carry into the night and disturb sleep
Steep, hillside terrain with lots of stairs and uphill walks to some rooms
Occasional cleanliness lapses reported (bathrooms, pool, grounds)
Infrequent shuttle (roughly every 2 hours) otherwise a ~1.5 km walk in the heat; reachable only by boat
notes: CONFIRMED REAL & OPERATING.
